explication: InstantSpaceSwitcher is a macOS menu-bar app and CLI for fast native Spaces switching. The main workflow is a menu, configured global shortcut, or CLI request reaching the ISS C API, which synthesizes a high-velocity trackpad gesture; the app also refreshes space state and can show an OSD. Settings cover general behavior and shortcut configuration, while optional swipe interception and Mission Control/Exposé detection are documented capabilities. Several runtime modules are indexed but not excerpted, so uncertain connections are omitted.
